HOW A NAME QUALIFIES FOR PKZ

1 · ZONE — on a timeframe that reads bullish (higher high and higher low), a line the price has touched 3 or more times.

2 · ALIGNED — 4 or more of the 7 frames (1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 1 hour, 4 hour, 1 day, 1 week) carry a live line touched 4+ times. The PKZ entry is the average of those lines.

3 · AT THE BUY PRICE — the live price trades 0.8% or more UNDER that entry, still above the lowest higher low and within 1.5% of the entry. The bot then places a limit buy at the entry minus 0.8%.

After the buy: it is sold the moment its price falls under its higher-low line, which is never more than 1.5% under the buy, or as soon as 4 or more of its 7 timeframes read bearish, whichever comes first. Once it is up 1% the stop locks +0.5%; once it is up the ARM RULE amount the stop keeps that much and trails 0.3% under its high. Every position is sold by 3:50 PM. One PKZ position at a time, using all of PKZ's free cash; a resting buy order counts as one.

STALE MARKET DATA — ENTRY GUARD SIMULATION RESEARCH
Default feed of last_price(): IEX (no timestamp check)
IEX price lag, normal minutes: p50 0 / p99 6 min; >=1 min old 13.9% (low decile 20.6%)
First-crossing false-entry rate (IEX above, SIP not): 7.95%
Blind episodes in bot.log: 56, 804 market min, worst 216 min
Normal: P1 120s vs P0 $+0.01, false 1 vs 1
Outage (EMP): P1 120s vs P0 $+0.31, false 0.98 vs 0.97
Frozen grid: false entries P0 20 vs P1 120s 20
Recommended threshold: none
last_price() reads the IEX feed (confirmed) with no timestamp check. In normal minutes the IEX print is at least one minute old 13.9% of the time (least-liquid decile 20.6%), so a freshness rule at 60/120/300 s would mark 13.9% / 5.8% / 1.4% of healthy minutes stale — every threshold is above the pre-registered 1% false-block bar. On the first IEX crossing of the trigger the SIP price disagrees 7.9% of the time, but mostly with a FRESH IEX print (36 of 449 same-minute crossings vs 0 of 4 stale ones), which no staleness rule can catch. Replayed on 235 live-rule candidates (36 engine entries, 115 sessions, 2024-09 to 2026-08) the rule changed P&L by pennies at 120/300 s (normal $+0.01 / $+0.00; per empirical outage session $+0.31 / $+0.15). False entries (SIP at or below the trigger when the bot decided): normal 1 under P0 vs 1 under P1 120 s; 20 blind stress cells 22 vs 21; 20 frozen cells 20 vs 20 — the rule removes at most one, and those it cannot see are same-minute IEX/SIP disagreements a few bp under the trigger. The 60 s variant's +$29 is one skipped losing trade, not an edge. Pre-registered bar: NO threshold passes; recommended threshold: none. The exposure outages actually create is on stops, which the rule does not touch: on open-position days an empirical outage crossed the stop line while blind in 2.3% of draws, and a 12:24-to-close outage would have missed the close-confirmed exit on 42 of 1318 position days.

HOW C4 TRADES · STEP BY STEPTHE TESTED RULE
1 · Once a monthTake the 70 most traded US stocks (by 12-month median dollars traded).
2 · 3:30 PMRank all 70 by how far each moved since the 9:30 open.
3 · PickKeep the weakest 20%: about 14 names that fell the most today.
4 · 3:45 PM · buyEqual dollars in each, using a fifth of the money each day (five lots, one per day).
5 · HoldNo stop. Each lot is held for five trading days.
6 · 3:50 PM, day 5 · sellSell the lot, and the next day's lot takes its place.
SafetySkip a name whose quote is more than 1% wide, or that another book holds. Never more money than C4 is given.

WHAT THIS DOES TO YOUR TRADES

Nothing. Not one of these gates an entry. They are on screen as weather, not as a rule.

All twenty were walk-forwarded as entry gates on the fused rule (regime_test.py). The last column is the share of 2,000 bootstrap histories in which gating on that signal beat not gating — the bar is 90%.

1 of 20 cleared. Testing twenty candidates at a 10% false-positive rate throws up 2.0 winners by chance, so one winner is fewer than chance predicts. XLU/SPY at 92.5% is what a lottery ticket looks like, and after correcting for twenty tests the bar is ~99.5%. None was adopted.

The bot’s own edge sits in 2018, 2020 and 2022 — exactly when SPY is under its long average. A regime gate deletes its best years and re-enters late. A filter that helps a dip-buyer hurts a breakout bot.
